title: Apple iPhone 15
author: Aarav
review_text: Excellent camera quality and good day-to-day battery. The design feels premium. The bad part is heating during long video recording, and charging speed is poor compared to competitors.

title: Apple iPhone 14
author: Mira
review_text: Good overall phone with excellent software stability and smooth performance. The bad side is slower charging, and low-light selfies can be poor.

title: Samsung Galaxy S23
author: Rohan
review_text: Excellent display brightness and good battery efficiency. Camera output is good in daylight. The bad thing is occasional heating in gaming, and call quality is poor in noisy places.

title: OnePlus 11
author: Sana
review_text: Excellent charging speed and good value for money. The UI is clean and performance is good. The bad part is camera consistency, and low-light video quality is poor.
